main_body: Sci-fi building: a sloped metal roof (trapezoid with panel seams and two vents) above a grey wall front with two cyan windows, two dark windows and a central double door.
top_band: Roof slope in light-to-mid blue-grey, rows 1-17, with a lighter grey front-edge band at rows 15-17 above a dark strip and an orange trim line at rows 19-20
evidence: Reading down the middle column: the roof slope is a large light blue-grey surface about 16 rows tall, ending in a light edge band at rows 15-17. Below it comes a dark strip and an orange eave line at rows 18-20, then the wall face from about row 21 to 44. The windows have dark inset frames with light sills, and the door has a dark frame with an inner shadow. The roof slope is clearly visible from above and sits over a distinct front face, so it reads as 3/4.

style.evidence: The roof has about 4 tones plus dark seam lines, with large flat panels of one blue-grey of roughly 7x5 px or more between the seams. The wall is mostly flat grey with only sparse speckle dots. The outline is dark navy. It is somewhat tinted but near-black in the roof border and the window frames. Next to the references, which have per-tile highlights, scalloped roof tiles and plaster or stone grain, the candidate has fewer steps, more flat fills and lower per-tile colour counts, so it looks thinner and flatter.
